questions.cardText:
[History] The Soviet Union detonated a nuclear bomb to extinguish a gas well fire in 1966. How did the bomb achieve this?
A. By collapsing the well
B. By creating a vacuum above the fire
C. By burning out the fuel
Answer: A. In 1966, the Soviet Union successfully used a 30-kiloton nuclear bomb to extinguish a burning gas well by creating an underground shockwave. It collapsed the well and sealed the gas leak, effectively extinguishing a fire that had been burning for over three years.
questions.de: Wie löschte die 30-Kilotonnen-Atombombe, die die Sowjetunion 1966 unterirdisch zündete, den brennenden Gasbrunnen von Urtabulak?
questions.en: How did the 30-kiloton nuclear bomb that the Soviet Union detonated underground in 1966 put out the burning gas well at Urtabulak?
questions.answerDe: Sie brachte das Bohrloch zum Einsturz und verschloss es
questions.answerEn: It collapsed and sealed the well

timeline.labelEn: Soviet 30-kiloton underground nuclear explosion seals the burning Urtabulak gas well in Uzbekistan
timeline.labelDe: Sowjetische 30-Kilotonnen-Atomexplosion verschließt den brennenden Gasbrunnen von Urtabulak in Usbekistan

questions.notes: Urtabulak field, Uzbek SSR; the blowout began 1 December 1963 and the fire burned 1,064 days until the blast on 30 September 1966 (detonated at about 1,500 m in an inclined borehole) — just under three years, not 'over three years' as the card says.

questions.cardText:
[Medical Sciences] Which one refers to the maximum rate an athlete’s body can consume oxygen during exercise?
A. Anaerobic value
B. VO2 max
C. Lactic acid threshold
Answer: B.
questions.de: Wie heißt die maximale Rate, mit der der Körper eines Sportlers bei Belastung Sauerstoff aufnehmen kann?
questions.en: What is the name for the maximum rate at which an athlete's body can consume oxygen during exercise?

timeline.labelEn: British physiologist A. V. Hill introduces the concept of maximal oxygen uptake (VO2 max)
timeline.labelDe: Der britische Physiologe A. V. Hill führt das Konzept der maximalen Sauerstoffaufnahme (VO2max) ein

questions.notes: Also called maximal oxygen uptake / maximal aerobic capacity; usually given per kilogram of body mass.
